steps.text: Press the tofu and cut into cubes.
Sear the tofu in half the oil for 3 minutes a side, then set aside.
steps.cue: The tofu has a golden crust on two sides and releases from the pan without sticking.
steps.tip: Leave the cubes alone for the full 3 minutes. Moving them early tears the crust.

steps.text: Stir-fry ginger, garlic and the vegetables in the rest of the oil for 5 minutes, add edamame and tofu, then soy sauce.
steps.cue: The vegetables are bright and still crisp-tender, and a thin glossy sauce coats everything.
steps.tip: The pan must be hot. Cook the vegetables in two batches if they do not fit in one layer.
